lowland-tropics.name: Lowland tropics
lowland-tropics.summary: Warm, humid lowlands with high rainfall and long growing seasons. Exact recommendations should be narrowed further by local soil, flooding and native range.
avoid: Non-native fast-growing species chosen only for speed
steps: Check local soil, water and flooding patterns
Plant during the locally suitable season

temperate-woodland.name: Temperate woodland
temperate-woodland.summary: Seasonal climates with distinct growing and dormant periods. Exact recommendations should be localized by soil, moisture and elevation.
steps: Check local frost and drought patterns
Plant at the locally appropriate time

semi-arid-grassland.name: Semi-arid grassland
semi-arid-grassland.summary: Dry landscapes where water availability can be the limiting factor. Restoration should consider the whole plant community, not just trees.
avoid: Planting water-hungry trees where they are not native
Large-scale planting without a water plan
steps: Confirm the ecosystem is suitable for tree planting
Choose drought-adapted native plants if appropriate
